test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He is good _________ mathematics.
solution:
The correct answer is '**at**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**at**" is used to indicate proficiency or skill in a particular subject.
 
• In this sentence, "**mathematics**" is the subject in which the individual is skilled.
